rules.title: Residential rental application fee capped at $50
rules.requirement: A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes that exceeds $50. Violations carry civil penalties collected through summary proceedings under the Penalty Enforcement Law of 1999, in Superior Court, Law Division, Special Civil Part.
rules.key_value: $50 max application fee; penalty up to $500 first offense, $750 second, $1,000 each subsequent offense

coverage.summary: Applies to any landlord or agent requiring an application or similar fee to lease or sublease residential rental property for dwelling purposes. The passage states no unit-count or building exemptions.

rules.effective_date_note: The passage is truncated and states no enactment or effective date. Status is assumed in force because the act is a chapter law, but the date is unverified.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
